policy: Do not redistribute images. Download from original repositories, retain attribution and licence, and collect Oman field photos with explicit owner consent.

datasets.name: Diseases of date palm leaves dataset
limitations: Not Oman data
Only leaf/leaflet symptoms
Augmented images must not enter test split
Small number of farms; farm-level holdout needed
datasets.citation: Namoun et al., Data in Brief 57 (2024), 110933, DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2024.110933

datasets.name: Image dataset of infected date palm leaves by dubas insects
limitations: Not Oman data
Drone imagery and field-scale domain differ from phone macro images
datasets.citation: Al-Mahmood et al., Data in Brief 49 (2023), 109371, DOI 10.1016/j.dib.2023.109371

datasets.name: Date palm RGB and thermal images for red palm weevil pest management
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 article; verify dataset terms before reuse
limitations: Labels partly based on farmer feedback
RGB and thermal modalities must be separated and documented
Not an Omani validation set
RGB alone cannot confirm or exclude internal trunk infestation
datasets.citation: Nadeem et al., Frontiers in Agronomy 7 (2025), DOI 10.3389/fagro.2025.1604188

datasets.name: Omani field image collection
datasets.license: owner-consented internal research; confirm terms before any public release
limitations: Requires images captured in Oman
Requires farm/tree-level metadata and qualified label review

datasets.name: Large-Scale Lemon Leaf Disease and Pest Image Dataset from Bangladesh
limitations: Not Oman data; Bangladesh only
Images collected against plain white backgrounds; field-domain shift expected
Review exact pest sub-class names and expert label metadata before mapping into the app taxonomy
datasets.citation: Arifen et al. (2026), Mendeley Data V3, DOI 10.17632/8d9fv6kpt3.3

datasets.name: LemonLENS real-world multi-class lemon leaf disease dataset
limitations: Not Oman data
Check archive folder structure and any processed/augmented derivatives before training
datasets.citation: Sagor and Ahmed (2025), Mendeley Data V2, DOI 10.17632/ccwh64fr2r.2

datasets.name: BDLemonLeaf healthy and diseased lemon leaves
limitations: Not Oman data
Annotation boxes and folder hierarchy require review before classification training
datasets.citation: Das et al. (2025), Mendeley Data V6, DOI 10.17632/643f5bbc2t.6

datasets.name: PlantDoc field plant-disease image dataset
datasets.geography: Multi-country web-sourced images; original capture geography varies/unknown
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 stated by repository; underlying scraped-image rights require item-level review
limitations: Images were annotated from internet-scraped sources; repository licence may not clear every underlying photograph
Mixed crops and heterogeneous capture conditions
Do not treat source geography or crop labels as locally validated
Review provenance and duplicate relationships before training
datasets.citation: Singh et al. (2020), PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection, DOI 10.1145/3371158.3371196

datasets.name: PlantVillage plant disease image dataset
datasets.geography: United States / controlled or laboratory-like image conditions
datasets.license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 stated on dataset card; source repository licensing is not fully consistent
limitations: Detached leaves and controlled backgrounds differ from real farm photography
High risk of learning background and capture artifacts
Verify exact archive snapshot and licence before use
Not suitable as sole training or validation evidence
datasets.citation: Mohanty, Hughes and Salathé (2016), Using Deep Learning for Image-Based Plant Disease Detection, DOI 10.3389/fpls.2016.01419

datasets.name: IP102 insect pest recognition dataset
datasets.license: Academic-use-only / non-commercial terms reported; exact terms must be checked at source
limitations: Do not use in a commercial product training pipeline without written rights clearance
Class imbalance and image-source variation
Not crop-specific diagnosis by itself
Check taxonomic names and class mapping
datasets.citation: Wu et al. (2019), IP102: A Large-Scale Benchmark Dataset for Insect Pest Recognition
